title: The Echo at the Underpass
youtube_title: The Echo at the Underpass | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Not every treasure needs to be pocketed.
summary: At a bedroom window on a frosty morning, Lior finds an echo that answered one soft hello. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Lior shows Femi how to look without disturbing it. Auntie June looks too, and they leave it where it is.
